'''Hoske''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was promoted to [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In order to celebrate his promotion, the newly appointed Admiral threw a party with his crew and ordered "special goods" to make sure that the party was a success.<ref name="Mission" />
